faqs.question: How do you prove zero data egress?
faqs.answer: Default-deny firewall plus Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, scripted egress probes hourly, and signed logs. We include the egress test pack and a data-flow diagram for your audits.

faqs.question: Do we need GPUs?
faqs.answer: Recommended for throughput and p95. A typical start is 4x L40S, or A100/H100 equivalents. CPU-only is fine for light loads or batch jobs, and we share a sizing guide. Private cloud is an option if you don't have your own hardware.

faqs.question: Will our apps need changes?
faqs.answer: Minimal. We expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so existing clients usually just point at a new base URL. Auth and rate limits are configured in the gateway.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Every engagement is scoped to your goals, so there's no single price. The initial call is always 100% **free**. The specification review will be used to give the most accurate estimation possible for a projects scope, price and duration.
